title: [Feature Request] Zed IDE integration support
body:
## Summary

Add official Zed IDE integration support for Claude Code, similar to existing VS Code and JetBrains integrations.

## Current Behavior

Running `/ide` in Claude Code terminal shows **"No available IDEs detected"** when Zed is the active editor. There is no Zed extension available for Claude Code.

## Requested Behavior

- A Claude Code extension for [Zed](https://zed.dev/) available in the Zed extensions marketplace
- `/ide` command detects a running Zed instance and connects to it
- Features on par with VS Code integration: file context sharing, diff viewing, selection context, diagnostic sharing

## Why This Matters

Zed is a modern, high-performance editor built in Rust with a growing developer community. It's especially popular among developers who value speed and minimalism. Many Claude Code users have switched to Zed as their primary editor and currently lack IDE integration.

## References

- [VS Code extension docs](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/ide-integrations)
- [JetBrains plugin docs](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/jetbrains)
- [Zed extensions API](https://zed.dev/docs/extensions/overview)
author: ptrtrg
